newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb gets new Eyewear president.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb gets new Eyewear president.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said Wednesday that its senior vice president of international operations Dwain Hahs has been promoted to executive vice president of the company and president of Bausch & Lomb Eyewear, one of the company's three core businesses.
Hahs will have worldwide responsibility for all aspects of the company's eyewear business, Bausch & Lomb said.
The company said it created the position as part of its ongoing transition to a globally aligned structure for its core businesses.
